message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are present anywhere in the visible code for incoming data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded via loadDataset and TUDataset/Dataset utilities with no checksum verification, authentication, or pinned revision visible in the code.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks for label-flipping anomalies, validates label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the training data anywhere in the visible code.

No detected model integrity verification: The code uses pickle and torch for loading data/models but performs no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision checks on any loaded artifacts.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any adversarial attack/stress test routines are present in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While evaluate_D uses separate D_app/D_test splits and computes both train and test performance metrics, there is no held-out isolation enforcement, data signing/hashing, or multiple independent metric validation to protect against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path in evaluate_D and the GED computation functions accept inputs directly without any shape, type, range, or schema validation before processing.
No detected output bounds checks: The evaluate_D function returns performance metrics and predictions without any NaN guards, sanity bounds, or threshold checks on the model outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a graph similarity/GED model, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
